column1: # Arabic pack (ar) cues and address words (2026-10-22).
# ar_cue: a word before a number (the article and the prefixes و ف ب ل ك removed) -> what it
#   makes of the number: ordm/ordf an ordinal agreeing with a masculine/feminine noun (المادة 3
#   المادة الثالثة), hour the hour (الساعة 9 التاسعة), phone and code digit by digit.
# ar_period: a word after an hour -> the period it states (فجرا, م مساء).
# ar_word: an address or code word read as an Arabic word (com كوم, news نيوز).
